g.text: Conflicting statements: "…bereavement fare up to 90 days after travel by…" vs "Customers
may not apply for the reduced bereavement fare…"
→ Keep one source of truth; if both must stay, make the date/scope explicit in each

"Approved refunds are processed within 14 days of the request."
→ Keep one source of truth; if both must stay, make the date/scope explicit in each
Credentials in a document: 1 OpenAI / Anthropic API key
→ Remove these credentials at the locations listed, rotate them, then re-scan. Anything
indexed can be retrieved and quoted to any user.

→ Remove or archive the older version, or mark it superseded (e.g. frontmatter `status:
superseded`, `superseded_by:`) so retrieval can filter it.

allowed to see it (enforce at retrieval time, not in the prompt).
